notif_list_editor: added you as an editor of “{title}”
notif_list_editor_generic: added you as an editor of a list
notif_report_action: Action was taken following your report.
notif_report_dismissed: No action was taken following your report.
notif_comment_removed: One of your comments was removed
notif_moderation_title: Action was taken on your account
notif_empty: Replies, mentions and new followers will show up here.
onboarding_welcome_intro: Movies, shows, anime, games, books and albums: what you watch, play, read and listen to, together in one place.
onboarding_welcome_progress_body: An episode watched, a book finished, a game in progress: Loomkeep remembers for you.
onboarding_welcome_releases_body: A calendar of what you follow, a digest of what's out, and which service to watch it on.
onboarding_welcome_xp_body: Earn XP, level up and unlock achievements.
onboarding_welcome_friends_body: Message them, share your reviews, build lists together.
onboarding_welcome_import_body: What you logged on TV Time, Trakt, Letterboxd or Goodreads can follow you here.
onboarding_welcome_android_body: A real app, home-screen widgets, and alerts you can answer without opening it.
onboarding_welcome_young: Loomkeep is a young project. An idea, a bug? Settings › Help & support: I read everything.
onboarding_domains_intro: Loomkeep only shows these domains. You can add more later.
onboarding_profile_intro: A photo and a username, so your friends find you. You can also do it later.
onboarding_settings_intro: Three quick choices. The rest follows your device.
onboarding_settings_theme_desc: The theater, lights off, or the programme, on paper.
onboarding_settings_services_desc: Shown first in "Where to watch". Offers for: {region}.
onboarding_settings_notify_desc: An episode, a movie or a game you follow comes out: it lands in your digest.
onboarding_settings_push_ask_phone: Android will ask for your permission.
onboarding_settings_push_ask_browser: Your browser will ask for your permission.
onboarding_settings_push_denied_phone: Refused. You can turn them back on in your phone's settings.
onboarding_settings_push_denied_browser: Blocked by the browser. You can allow them again from the padlock in the address bar.
onboarding_settings_email_desc: Your week's releases, once a week.
onboarding_settings_later: Everything can be changed later in Settings
onboarding_settings_device: Language ({language}) and time zone ({timezone}) come from your device. Everything can be changed in Settings.
onboarding_done_intro: Here's your membership card. It's yours to fill.
onboarding_done_first_steps_desc: They're waiting on your home page. Finish them to unlock the "{achievement}" achievement.
onboarding_acquisition_title: How did you hear about Loomkeep?
onboarding_settings_push_desc_iphone: On iPhone, install Loomkeep to your home screen first (Share → Add to Home Screen) to receive these. They let you know as soon as a new episode airs, or something new shows up, for what you follow.
onboarding_settings_newsletter_desc: An occasional email, only to keep you posted on new features.
stats_premium_block: Some statistics, like your ratings breakdown, decades, what you own and your activity over time, are for premium members only.
home_phone_editor_note: This phone only: the computer keeps its own home grid.
home_starter_title: Your screening room is empty for now.
home_starter_body: Add a first title: your home fills itself with what you watch, play and read.
home_nothing_listening: Nothing to listen to right now.
home_widget_to_watch_description: Shows in progress and movies to watch, the next episode one click away.
home_widget_this_week_description: Upcoming releases of what you follow: episodes, movies and games.
home_widget_resume_description: Shows in progress you've left aside for over 30 days.
home_widget_games_description: The games you're playing right now.
home_widget_books_description: Your current reads and the page you're on.
home_widget_reading_goal_description: Where you stand on this year's reading goal.
home_widget_music_description: The albums you've set aside for later.
home_widget_activity_description: What your friends recently watched, played or read.
home_widget_quick_links_description: The app pages and websites you want close at hand.
home_widget_my_lists_description: Your lists, and the ones you contribute to.
home_widget_list_content_description: The works of a list of your choice.
home_widget_saved_view_description: A saved search of your library, with its filters and sort.
home_saved_view_unset: Pick the view to show in the widget's settings.
home_saved_view_config_none: You don't have any views yet. Save one from any of your libraries, with "Save view".
home_nothing_to_resume: No show on hold: everything's on track.
home_activity_empty: Nothing new from your friends for now.
home_list_content_unset: Pick the list to show in the widget's settings.
home_list_content_missing: This list no longer exists, or you no longer have access to it.
home_list_content_empty: This list is empty for now.
home_widget_divider_horizontal_descripti: A hairline between two rows of widgets.
home_widget_divider_vertical_description: A hairline between two columns of widgets. Hidden on a phone, where the home page is stacked.
home_catalog_intro: Once placed, every widget can be moved and resized.
home_catalog_group_resume_description: What you're in the middle of, back in one click.
home_catalog_group_follow_description: Upcoming releases, your goals, what your friends are up to.
home_catalog_group_collections_descripti: Your lists and picks, close at hand.
home_catalog_group_layout_description: Shortcuts and dividers to give your home page some structure.
home_editor_needs_widget: Add at least one widget to save.
home_widget_note_description: A reminder of your own, shown as you write it.
home_note_empty: Write your note in the widget's settings.
home_note_placeholder: A film you fancy, a reminder, a shopping list…
home_widget_favorites_description: Your favorite works, every domain mixed.
home_widget_tonight_pick_description: Every day, a work from your watchlist — never the same two days running.
home_widget_on_this_day_description: What you were watching, reading or playing on this day last year.
home_widget_quick_search_description: A search field on your home page, in the domain of your choice.
home_on_this_day_empty: Nothing logged around this date last year.
home_tonight_pick_empty: Add works to watch to get an idea every day.
home_config_lists_all: Mine and those shared with me
home_editor_reset: Go back to the default home page
home_editor_reset_confirm: Your layout will be replaced by the original one, which follows the domains you turn on. Continue?
home_editor_leave_confirm: Your home page changes aren't saved. Leave anyway?
home_editor_using_default: You're using the default home page: it follows the domains you turn on, until you edit it.
home_editor_narrow_hint: On this screen, the home page stacks the widgets in grid order: top to bottom, then left to right.
home_editor_keyboard_hint: With a keyboard: arrows move a widget, Shift + arrows resize it.
home_quick_links_config_invalid_url: Enter an address starting with http:// or https://.
home_list_content_config_none: You don't have any lists yet. Create one from "My lists".
stats_empty: Nothing to display yet. Track some works to see your stats.
news_banner_maintenance_same_day: Maintenance is planned on {date}, from {start} to {end}: Loomkeep will be unavailable in the meantime.
news_banner_maintenance_range: Maintenance is planned from {start} to {end}: Loomkeep will be unavailable in the meantime.
news_banner_degraded_service: Some services are disrupted right now. We're working to restore everything as soon as possible.
stats_ownership_required: Add ownership information to your works to enable this statistic.
stats_video_tracking_hint: How many started series are waiting for a decision.
stats_video_history_hint: Actual history (including TV Time imports) — last 365 days.
stats_social_comparison_sample: Across {count} works rated in common — are you stricter or more generous?
stats_social_insufficient_comparison: Not enough works rated in common with other members to compare ({count} so far).
notif_api_keys_review_one: Your password changed, but your API key stays valid.
notif_api_keys_review_many: Your password changed, but your {count} API keys stay valid.
notif_api_key_leaked_body: Your key "{name}" was found in public on GitHub. It no longer works: create a new one.
notif_api_key_expiring_body: Your key "{name}" expires in less than a week.
notif_saga_sequel_body: A new entry in the {saga} saga
notif_import_finished_body: The result is waiting in your settings.
notif_import_failed_body: It couldn't finish. The details are in your settings.
notif_reactions_on: Your comment on “{work}” is getting reactions
notif_moderation_message_removed: One of your messages was removed
notif_moderation_review_removed: One of your reviews was removed
notif_moderation_list_removed: One of your lists was deleted
notif_moderation_list_edited: One of your lists was edited
notif_moderation_profile_edited: Your profile was edited by moderation
notif_page_subtitle: Read notifications are kept for 90 days.
notif_empty_unread: Nothing left unread. The history stays under “All”.
home_widget_my_year_description: What you watched, played, read and heard this year, for your domains.
home_my_year_empty: Turn a domain on to see your year.
